svg.title: What you can produce versus what you can judge
svg.desc: As you move away from your expertise, what you can produce with AI stays high. What you can produce without AI falls off first. Your judgement of code falls off next, and your judgement of the product falls off much later. Below the code judgement curve you can judge both the code and the product. Between the two judgement curves you can judge the product but not the code. Above the product judgement curve, you can produce work you can't judge, and someone else has to review it.
